title: WorkSpaces, AppStream 2.0 and Secure Browser

kcs.statement: Amazon WorkSpaces provides managed, persistent virtual desktops (Windows or Linux) that users reach from almost any device, replacing on-premises virtual desktop infrastructure.
Amazon AppStream 2.0 streams individual desktop applications to a web browser without giving each user a full desktop.
Amazon WorkSpaces Secure Browser gives workers access to internal websites and SaaS apps through a secure browser session, without data being stored on their devices.

problem_ideas: 200 contractors need a full Windows desktop for 3 months from their own laptops: which service?
Students need one CAD application in a browser, not a desktop: which service?
Call-centre staff should reach an internal web portal with no files left on their devices: which service?
Spot the distractor: 'AppStream 2.0 provides persistent desktops with a user's own files.'
A company is closing an office and wants desktops without shipping hardware: justify WorkSpaces.
Classify five end-user needs as WorkSpaces, AppStream 2.0 or Secure Browser.
